newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Helix intersects more Gawler gold.
newsitem.headline: Helix intersects more Gawler gold.

text.p: Gawler Craton gold explorer Helix Resources NL said on Tuesday its third line of drilling at its Timkillia Prospect had intersected gold at various grades.

"Further significant gold mineralisation has been intersected from the company's third line of drilling (17100E) at Area 223 on the Timkillia Prospect in the Gawler Craton region of South Australia," Helix said.
Previous announcements had reported results from lines 16900E and 17000E and five drillholes had been completed to date on the new line 17100E.
"The five angled reverse circulation drillholes on line 17100E (LRC 31 to LRC 35) appear to have intersected at least three mineralised zones, each up to 20 metres true width," Helix said.
The last drillhole in the line found mineralisation of 2.5 grammes per tonne over 36 metres.
The results of the five drill holes follow.
